title: NHCB conversion corrupts data
body:
### What did you do?

I configured prometheus 3.5.0 to convert all classic histograms to NHCB and send them to mimir 2.17

### What did you expect to see?

I expected all histograms to be converted and reach mimir

### What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?

Some time series were not converted properly, and mimir refused them with the following error message:

```
time=2025-09-03T12:29:40.728Z level=ERROR source=queue_manager.go:1668 msg="non-recoverable error" component=remote remote_name=a5a23e url=http://mimir-testing-distributor.mimir-testing.svc.cluster.local:8080/api/v1/push failedSampleCount=1932 failedHistogramCount=68 failedExemplarCount=0 err="server returned HTTP status 400 Bad Request: send data to ingesters: failed pushing to ingester mimir-testing-ingester-zone-a-0: user=anonymous: err: custom buckets: only 0 custom bounds defined which is insufficient to cover total span length of 5: histogram custom bounds are too few. timestamp=2025-09-03T12:29:40.452Z, series=[{__name__ cortex_request_message_bytes} {cluster global-testing} {container ingester} {endpoint http-metrics} {garden global} {instance 10.19.254.68:8080} {job mimir-testing/ingester} {method gRPC} {namespace mimir-testing} {pod mimir-testing-ingester-zone-a-1} {prometheus monitoring-testing/clustermon-global-testing-prometheus} {prometheus_replica prometheus-clustermon-global-testing-prometheus-0} {route /cortex.Ingester/QueryExemplars} {service mimir-testing-ingester-zone-a}] (err-mimir-native-histogram-custom-buckets-mismatch) (sampled 1/10)\n"   
```

This happened with multiple services, the jobs hitting this error included mimir-testing/ingester, kubelet, loki-testing/ingester, apiserver, traefik

These specific timeseries were never converted properly, there were no datapoints in mimir in the 25 minutes while this configuration running. Other timeseries for the same metric name went through fine. 

### System information

Linux 6.1.144-170.251.amzn2023.aarch64 aarch64

### Prometheus version

```text
prometheus, version 3.5.0 (branch: HEAD, revision: 8be3a9560fbdd18a94dedec4b747c35178177202)
  build user:       root@4451b64cb451
  build date:       20250714-16:18:17
  go version:       go1.24.5
  platform:         linux/arm64
  tags:             netgo,builtinassets
```

### Prometheus configuration file

```yaml
global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    garden: global
    prometheus: monitoring-testing/clustermon-global-testing-prometheus
    prometheus_replica: prometheus-clustermon-global-testing-prometheus-0
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: true
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  evaluation_interval: 30s
...
remote_write:
- url: http://mimir-testing-distributor.mimir-testing.svc.cluster.local:8080/api/v1/push
  send_native_histograms: true
  enable_http2: false
  queue_config:
    min_shards: 4
```
